description: Compute separately weighted cohesion, alignment and separation steering over supplied neighbor pairs.
output_invariants: points and velocities have equal N and finite pairs. Pairs are strict lexicographic i<j original indices. Output has N fresh finite positive-zero canonical pairs. It is a steering transform, not an integrator or retained graph.

behavior.validation: Exact passive plain/null-prototype records, dense arrays with own data slots, finite point/velocity/coefficient values, nonnegative cohesion/alignment/separation/maxSteer and safe maxWork. Full validation precedes work. Each array length<=4294967295; columns*rows must be a safe integer<=4294967295 with exact value-array correspondence. Full numeric validation before work; no aliases/mutation/partial output. Exposed zeros canonical positive. Proxies outside interchange.
behavior.law: For each agent: cohesion*(mean neighbor position-own position) plus alignment*(mean neighbor velocity-own velocity) plus separation*mean over noncoincident normalized outward vectors. Position/velocity means use total degree; separation mean uses noncoincident degree only. Zero degree returns positive zero; coincident neighbors contribute alignment/cohesion but no invented separation direction. Cap raw steering by fdlibmHypot and maxSteer. Zero coefficients do not skip arithmetic. Any intermediate sum, difference or norm that overflows fails, even if a real-number mean, zero-weight result, or capped vector would be finite.
behavior.order: After N+P work approval, visit canonical pairs. For each [i,j], accumulate j position x,y then velocity x,y and degree into i; accumulate i values in the same x/y order into j; calculate dx then dy then fdlibm length; for nonzero length add normalized outward x,y/noncoincident degree to i then negated x,y/count to j. Visit agents ascending; calculate cohesion x,y, alignment x,y, separation x,y, raw x/y, then cap scale/x/y. Canonical order fixes observable binary64 accumulation.
behavior.work: Charge N+P after static validation and before output allocation. Time/storage O(N+P).
behavior.environment: No neighbor query, integration, speed cap, field, boundary, clock, RNG, renderer or species policy.
behavior.numerics: Ordered separate binary64 primitives; finite-check every computed primitive. fdlibm sin/cos/hypot existing audited implementations. Exact shared fixture outputs; independent trigonometric analytical oracles abs1e-12 relative0, indices/errors/counters exact. No epsilon in classification.
behavior.native_surface: flockSteer2D(input); p5-only initial target, named package export; errors carry stable code.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: carrier, finite/domain, correspondence or canonical pair failure
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: nonfinite subtraction, norm, divide, accumulation, term or cap primitive
